title: Irish Visa Decision Tracker: published visa decisions by office
description: Published Irish visa decision counts for New Delhi, Beijing, Dublin, Abu Dhabi, Abuja and Ankara, compiled from the offices' official files. Version 2026-11-24 contains 62,920 decisions in the latest files across 6 offices. The tracker is independent and unofficial; underlying decisions remain the publications of the Irish embassies and the Immigration Service Delivery.
